7.7.1.2 Monitor status and UDS status update
Status bit processing is an essential part of the Dem functionality. SWCs or BSW modules frequently report monitor results via the API Dem_SetEventStatus. A call of these functions will trigger the status bit processing of the Dem. According to ISO 14229-1[2] monitor, event or DTC status cannot be used to control safety critical functionality. There are various situations e.g. enable conditions or the UDS service ControlDTCSetting that can block processing of these status information.
[SWS_Dem_01278] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈The Dem shall provide a monitor status per event to store current monitor state information. The monitor status contains the information as defined in Dem_MonitorStatusType.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01279] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04068
⌈The Dem shall perform the counter based event debouncing synchronously within the context of the calling Dem_SetEventStatus function.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01280] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈Upon call of Dem_SetEventStatus and after debouncing, the Dem shall process the monitor status in the same manner as the UDS status:
• Bit0 (TestFailed) according to [SWS_Dem_00386]
• Bit1 (TestNotCompleteThisOperationCycle) according to [SWS_Dem_00394]. The monitor status byte processing shall be done synchronously within the context of the calling Dem_SetEventStatus function.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01281] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈If the parameter DemGeneralCallbackMonitorStatusChangedFnc is configured, the Dem shall call this configured C function with the signature of <Module> _DemTriggerOnMonitorStatus.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01282] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈Upon processing the monitor status, the Dem shall call the monitor status changed callback functions:
• <Module>_DemTriggerOnMonitorStatus whenever the monitor status has changed.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01283] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
